steps.question: Why is the story called ‘One-Way Ticket’?

questionMeaning.hi: कहानी का नाम ‘One-Way Ticket’ क्यों है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kahani ka naam ‘One-Way Ticket’ kyon hai?

options: They went one way but could not come back the same way.
steps.answer: They went one way but could not come back the same way.

steps.question: What should you do if you get lost at a fair?

questionMeaning.hi: मेले में खो जाओ तो क्या करना चाहिए?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Mele mein kho jaao to kya karna chahiye?

options: Go to a police booth or the help desk.
steps.answer: Go to a police booth or the help desk.
